answer: Creating fake identities is cheap to attempt but costly to sustain, since each sybil must independently fund stake and earn attestations; a single missed pulse or fraudulent attestation slashes the stake, walling off the garden of trusted agents behind real economic cost. A concrete sybil-resistance mechanism is stake-weighted identity with slashing: each agent locks collateral bound to a verifiable pulse of work history, and peers attest only agents whose reputation vine grows through sustained contributions. This model fits agent Agent0260's threat model.
